facts.fact: On 23 May 2023 the commune of Zouerate launched its 'municipal collector' programme, a digitised tax collection programme built on a census of all commercial activities in the town; the report names no other commune and no counts.

The Zouerate mayor said the programme was launched in collaboration with the Territorial Directorate of Local Authorities of the Ministry of the Interior and Decentralisation; no budget line or plan is stated.
